tweet.text: From 2007 to 2015, Tama the cat rose from stationmaster at the unmanned Kishi station in Japan, to ‘super stationmaster’, to Vice President of the railway, and, after her death, to ‘Honourable Eternal Stationmaster’ and a Shinto goddess. (Image: Sanpei)
